purpose: Blind labels for all 2,841 train clips (947 rubrics x 3 generators), by Claude Sonnet 5.5 subagents in batches of about 5 clips. Each saw only caption, rubric and video frames (overview + full-rate zooms), no teacher output and no earlier annotation. sa_score / pc_score are computed with teacher/scoring.py from the item statuses. 2026-10-02: the rubric gained a scene-wide universal fatal item (policy universal_pc_item); its status was blind-judged for 537 clips and inferred pass for the rest (items[].source). The pre-universal file is train_blind_sonnet_v1_pre_universal.json; pc_score_before_universal keeps the old PC per clip.
sampling: All train clips; the first batch of 50 was stratified by branch and generator, later batches covered the remainder. One record per (id, tag).
confidence: One clip_confidence per video for the whole rubric (high / medium / low) with a one-sentence reason; no per-item confidence.
universal_item: P6 'universal' (fatal, permanence_count) added 2026-10-01; status from supplementary blind judging for 537 clips (pilot 100 + main 437) and inferred pass for the other 2,304; see items[].source and items[].evidence.
source_file: teacher/review/train_blind_sonnet.json (identical records, split by tag on 2026-10-04)

clips.caption: Sand is sprinkled on a cymbal and a violin bow is drawn along its edge, and the sand jumps and gathers into lines.
clips.clip_confidence_reason: Grains are tiny and dense so hop and pattern changes are hard to separate from static texture.
clips.clip_summary: A cymbal with a mound of orange sand, a bow standing vertically with its frog resting on the cymbal's near edge at left, held roughly still throughout. A dense cloud of grains is in the air over the whole 5 s, with radial ridges in the sand on the right that are already present at 0s. The sand does not visibly reorganise into new lines.

uncovered.what: Sand pattern and airborne grains already present at 0s with no visible bowing motion

items.check: Sand is sprinkled onto a cymbal, or lies sprinkled on it.
items.evidence: Sand lies heaped on the cymbal from 0s.

items.check: A violin bow is drawn along the cymbal's edge.
items.evidence: The bow stands vertical with its frog on the edge and is not drawn along the edge in any frame.

items.check: The sand jumps.
items.evidence: Many grains are airborne above the cymbal throughout.

items.check: The sand gathers into lines.
items.evidence: Radial ridges are already there at 0s and no new lines form during the clip.

items.check: The bow moves first and the sand jumps after; the lines form from the jumping.
items.evidence: No bow stroke is seen, and no line formation follows from jumping.

items.expect: The sand lies still until the bow touches the edge, hops while the bow moves and settles when it lifts.
items.fail: Sand hops before the bow touches the cymbal; or hops while the bow is held away; or the bow is drawn and the sand lies dead still; or the sand goes on hopping well after the bow has lifted.
items.evidence: Grains are in the air while the bow touches the cymbal; the bow never lifts, so settling is not tested.

items.expect: The hopping gathers the sand into lines or patches that stay after the bow lifts; no pattern exists before the bowing.
items.fail: Lines appear fully formed before or without any hopping; or a pattern forms and then dissolves back to an even sprinkle while the sand is still; or the pattern slides as a whole around the cymbal like a picture.
items.evidence: Ridge patterns are present at 0s alongside hopping grains already in the air; none dissolves or slides as a whole.

items.expect: Grains fall back onto the cymbal or off its edge.
items.fail: Grains hang in the air; or float up; or grains that fell off return up onto the cymbal.
items.evidence: No grains seen hanging still or rising back onto the cymbal.

items.expect: The cymbal is a rigid metal disc that may wobble; the bow is rigid; the grains stay separate.
items.fail: The cymbal ripples like water; or the bow bends double; or the sand flows as a liquid puddle.
items.evidence: Cymbal, bow and grains stay rigid and granular.

items.expect: One cymbal, one bow; the sand keeps its amount, allowing for grains falling off.
items.fail: Sand appears from nowhere; or all the sand vanishes; or the bow passes through the cymbal; or the cymbal changes shape.
items.evidence: One cymbal, one bow; sand amount looks steady.
